from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for k,row in enumerate(g):
        if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg:
            sep=row[0]
            top_border=sep in g[0]
            bottom_border=sep in g[-1]
            active_bottom = top_border and not bottom_border
            if not top_border and not bottom_border:
                active_bottom = h-k-1>k
            if active_bottom:
                ref=k-1; near=k+1; far=h-1; rows=range(k+1,h)
            else:
                ref=k+1; near=k-1; far=0; rows=range(k)
            source=max(r for r in rows if any(v not in (bg,sep) for v in g[r]))
            far=h-2 if source==h-4 else h-1
            for r in rows:
                for c in range(w):
                    v=g[r][c]
                    if v not in (bg,sep):
                        g[r][c]=bg
                        g[near if g[ref][c]==v else far][c]=v
            return g
    for k in range(w):
        col=[g[r][k] for r in range(h)]
        if len(set(col))==1 and col[0]!=bg:
            sep=col[0]
            left_border=sep in g[0][:k]
            right_border=sep in g[0][k+1:]
            active_right = left_border and not right_border
            if not left_border and not right_border:
                active_right = w-k-1>k
            if active_right:
                ref=k-1; near=k+1; far=w-1; cols=range(k+1,w)
            else:
                ref=k+1; near=k-1; far=0; cols=range(k)
            source=max(c for c in cols if any(g[r][c] not in (bg,sep) for r in range(h)))
            far=w-2 if source==w-4 else w-1
            for r in range(h):
                for c in cols:
                    v=g[r][c]
                    if v not in (bg,sep):
                        g[r][c]=bg
                        g[r][near if g[r][ref]==v else far]=v
            return g
    return g
